dedupe_keys.name: model america data and building energy models of every u s building autobem

description: Model America is the Oak Ridge National Laboratory dataset that gives a building energy model for almost every building in the United States, generated with the AutoBEM software suite, which extracts building descriptors from imagery and other data and simulates them on high performance computers. The OSTI record for Model America v1 reports 125,715,609 buildings detected, of which 122,146,671 (97.2%) produced a model, with OpenStudio and EnergyPlus model files zipped by county and state CSV inputs giving a unique building identifier, centroid, footprint, area, height, number of floors, window-to-wall ratio by facade, ASHRAE climate zone, DOE prototype building type and vintage. An update on 6 September 2026 replaced the building identifier with the PNNL Unique Building Identifier without recomputing results. Coverage: the United States. Access: OSTI and ORNL Constellation records, with downloads through Globus. Licence: stated as free and openly available, as-is. Caveats: models are inferred from footprints, heights and prototypes, not from audits, so individual buildings may be mis-typed. Simulation uses are national and city building energy simulation, grid and climate scenario studies, and training data for building energy estimation. Related records: the AutoBEM Arizona 2022 results, EnergyPlus, OpenStudio, ResStock and ComStock.
